session_read: Friday 2026-08-28 was not a broad risk-off. SMH fell 3.47% while AMZN, MSFT, GOOG and BABA rose -- capital moved out of the AI supply chain and into the investment-grade companies buying from it. For a book that is 89.4% AI-capex chain, that distinction is the whole story. The mechanism smith-catalyst names is credit, not earnings: NVDA's 5-year CDS has roughly doubled in two months and Oracle was cut to BBB-. Aggregate open risk sits at 13.16% against a 10% cap while cash is 3.01%, below its floor -- so every idea this run is the buy leg of a rotation, not an add.
